heading_path: Part 9—Removal of trade mark from Register for nonuse
9.9  Filing of statement of grounds and particulars
text: (1) A statement of grounds and particulars must be filed within one month from the day the notice of intention to oppose is filed. (2) The statement must be in an approved form.
title: Filing of statement of grounds and particulars
